换一种路口，看车流怎样改变: Try another junction and watch the traffic change
左转不再等红灯。上环和下环的车却要在同一小段路上交叉换道，车一多，先堵在这里。: Left turns no longer wait at traffic lights. Vehicles entering and leaving the loops must weave across the same short stretch; this is where queues first form as demand rises.
支路的车要等主路留出足够大的空当，才能拐出去。: Vehicles on the side road wait for a large enough gap in the main-road traffic before turning out.
两组车流轮流通过。左转亮绿灯时，仍要等对向直行的车。: The two streams take turns. Even with a green light, left-turning vehicles must yield to oncoming through traffic.
转弯让直行，相对方向的右转车让左转车；没有优先道路时，让右侧来车。: Turning traffic yields to through traffic, and right turns yield to oncoming left turns. Without a priority road, give way to traffic from the right.
进环的车让环内车先行，把交叉冲突变成四处合流与四处分流。: Entering vehicles yield to circulating traffic, replacing crossing conflicts with four merges and four diverges.
左转先进入待转区，等专用绿灯一起出发。用进口展宽和额外相位，换取互不交叉的放行。: Left turns enter a waiting area first, then leave together on their dedicated green. Wider approaches and extra phases separate the movements.
高速跨过主干道。四条匝道把转向交给两端的信号路口，两个路口要一起协调。: The freeway crosses above the arterial. Four ramps bring turning traffic to two signalized terminals, whose operation must be coordinated.
两次交叉，把中间一段换成左侧行驶。上匝道的左转车不用再横穿对向直行。: Two crossovers switch the middle section to left-hand traffic. Left turns onto the freeway no longer cross opposing through traffic.
通过量来自本次会话的压力测试；未测试显示 —。面积包含图中引道，占地为路面外包凸: Throughput comes from this session’s demand sweeps; — means untested. Areas include the displayed approach roads. Footprint is an estimate from the pavement convex hull.
高度由图层与净空约束反推，非实测高程: Heights inferred from layers and clearance constraints, not surveyed
四条左转匝道直接越过中心，车辆不用交织。省下绕环的路程，换来更高的桥和更多桥面。: Four direct left-turn ramps cross above the center without weaving. Shorter routes require taller bridges and more elevated pavement.
左转沿着中心向外旋开，用更长、更舒展的匝道避开交织。高速不断流，桥也铺得更远。: Left turns spiral around the center on longer, gentler ramps. Traffic flows without weaving, while bridges spread across more land.
三条高速相遇，一个慢速环道加一条半定向匝道，就能让所有方向互通。: Three highway arms connect through a slow loop and a semidirectional ramp, providing every turning movement.
两个象限加上环形匝道，部分左转绕过去。留下的信号路口仍需等待，也多占了一块土地。: Loops in two quadrants carry some left turns around the junctions. The remaining signalized terminals still require waiting, and the loops use more land.
左转在上游先穿过对向车道，来到道路外侧等待。到主路口时，左转和对向直行可以一起走: Left turns cross opposing traffic upstream and wait on the far side. At the main junction they can move alongside opposing through traffic.
真实道路在山谷里层层相接。线形来自 OpenStreetMap；桥面高度由层号、: Real roads overlap through a valley. Alignments come from OpenStreetMap; deck heights are inferred from layers, grades and clearance, not surveyed.
